name: Basic Electronics Company Ltd (Al-Asasyah)
note: Al-Khobar-based electronics and appliances company; its website's about page says the limited liability company is owned by Mohammed Ahmed Al-Arfaj and describes it as a 100% Saudi company. Its GREE section (al-asasyah.com/new/ar/gree/) describes the company as the agent ('وكيلنا') of the GREE air-conditioner brand in Saudi Arabia.
